body.zh-Hant: 德博諾1866年3月19日生於卡薩諾達達。1884年他在維洛納宣誓入伍，1887至88年自願參加厄立特里亞的非洲戰事，1912年被派往利比亞擔任後勤總部參謀長，並參加義土戰爭。
body.en: De Bono was born at Cassano d'Adda on 19 March 1866. He took his oath at Verona in 1884, volunteered for the African campaign in Eritrea in 1887-88, and in 1912 was sent to Libya as chief of staff of the logistics command, taking part in the Italo-Turkish war.

citations.quote: Nacque a Cassano d'Adda, in provincia di Milano, il 19 marzo 1866
nel 1884 prestò giuramento a Verona
Volontario nella campagna d'Africa nel 1887-88 - in Eritrea
venne inviato in Libia come capo di Stato Maggiore
partecipò alla guerra italo-turca

body.zh-Hant: 1915年他指揮在伊松佐河作戰的第2軍；1916年任特拉帕尼旅旅長，後被調往阿爾巴尼亞戰線。1918年初回國，接掌格拉帕山的第9軍，同年6月因擊退奧軍猛烈攻擊獲薩伏依軍事勳章指揮官級；1919年改任第22軍軍長。
body.en: In 1915 he commanded the II Army Corps operating on the Isonzo; in 1916 he led the Trapani brigade and was then posted to the Albanian front. Back in Italy in early 1918 he took the IX Army Corps on Monte Grappa, and in June won the Commander's cross of the Military Order of Savoy for repelling a violent Austrian attack. In 1919 he commanded the XXII Corps.

citations.quote: Nel 1915 comandò il II corpo d'armata che operava sull'Isonzo
divenne comandante della brigata Trapani
fu destinato sul fronte albanese
assunse il comando del IX corpo d'armata sul monte Grappa
Rientrato in Italia all'inizio del 1918
per aver respinto un violento attacco austriaco
nel 1919 ebbe il comando del XXII corpo d'armata

heading.zh-Hant: 法西斯民兵與公共安全

body.zh-Hant: 1922年10月16日，他出席決定進軍羅馬策略的米蘭會議；11月11日墨索里尼任命他為公共安全總局長，其後又任命他統率法西斯民兵。馬泰奧蒂事件引發的危機迫使他辭去公共安全總局長職務；他在參議院高等法院受審六個月後獲判無罪。
body.en: He attended the Milan meeting of 16 October 1922 that decided the strategy of the March on Rome. On 11 November 1922 Mussolini made him head of Public Security and later also named him commander of the Fascist army, the militia. The crisis after the Matteotti murder forced him to resign from public security, and after a six-month trial before the Senate he was acquitted.

citations.quote: Alla riunione di Milano del 16 ott. 1922
nella quale fu decisa la strategia della marcia su Roma
capo della Pubblica Sicurezza l'11 nov. 1922
nominò anche comandante dell'esercito fascista
alle dimissioni dalla direzione generale della Pubblica Sicurezza
Il processo si chiuse dopo sei mesi con l'assoluzione dei D.

body.zh-Hant: 德博諾1925年7月被任命為的黎波里塔尼亞總督，任期持續到1928年。1928年底回國，先任殖民地部次長，1929年9月成為殖民地部長。1935年1月16日，他被任命為東非高級專員。
body.en: De Bono was appointed governor of Tripolitania in July 1925 and held the post until 1928. Recalled at the end of 1928, he became first under-secretary and then, in September 1929, minister of the Colonies. On 16 January 1935 he was named high commissioner for East Africa.

citations.quote: Il D. fu nominato governatore della Tripolitania nel luglio 1925 e fino al 1928
Richiamato in patria alla fine del 1928
nominato prima sottosegretario di Stato al ministero delle Colonie
nel settembre 1929
il 16 genn. 1935 fu infatti nominato alto commissario per l'Africa orientale

body.zh-Hant: 衣索比亞戰役中，1935年10月6日意軍抵達阿杜瓦，10月中旬佔領阿克蘇姆，11月9日德博諾推進至馬卡累，但不願再深入。墨索里尼決定以巴多利奧取代他；他事後因在衣索比亞的作為獲得元帥稱號。
body.en: On 6 October 1935 Italian troops reached Adwa and in mid-October Axum was occupied; on 9 November De Bono pushed on towards Makalle but did not think he should go further. Mussolini then decided to replace him with Badoglio; as a reward for his activity in Ethiopia he later received the title of marshal.

citations.quote: Il 6 ottobre le truppe italiane raggiunsero Adua
Alla metà del mese fu occupata Axum
Il 9 novembre, nonostante tutte le esitazioni e le cautele
sostituirlo nella carica con Badoglio
ebbe poi il titolo di maresciallo

heading.en: Later years and the Grand Council

body.zh-Hant: 1939年底他被任命為海外部隊總監，1940年6月接掌南方各軍團，但據來源所述並未接近前線。1943年7月25日大議會會議上，他是墨索里尼之後第一位發言者，講話集中於武裝部隊狀況，並未直接要求罷免墨索里尼。
body.en: At the end of 1939 he was named inspector of overseas troops and in June 1940 took command of the armies of the South, but he never approached the front lines. At the Grand Council session of 25 July 1943 he was the first to speak after the Duce; his speech centred on the armed forces and made no direct demand for Mussolini's removal.

citations.quote: fu nominato ispettore delle truppe. d'Oltremare
nel giugno del 1940 assunse il comando delle armate del Sud
senza mai avvicinarsi alle linee del fronte
nella seduta del 25 luglio 1943 fu il primo a parlare dopo il duce
non avanzò alcuna richiesta diretta alla destituzione di Mussolini

heading.zh-Hant: 警察職務與殖民地部任期的起迄
heading.en: Start and end of his police and colonial posts

body.zh-Hant: 德博諾1922年11月11日被任命為公共安全總局長，1924年6月18日離開該職。1935年1月他離開殖民地部，改任東非高級專員，之後成為準備出征部隊的總司令。
body.en: De Bono was appointed Director General of Public Security on 11 November 1922 and left the post on 18 June 1924. In January 1935 he left the Ministry of the Colonies to become High Commissioner for East Africa, and later commander in chief of the troops destined for the war.

body.zh-Hant: 亞基諾（Treccani 作 Jachino）1889年4月24日生於聖雷莫，1904年8月15日進入海軍學院。他以少尉身分登上戰艦「瑪格麗特王后」號，參與1908年12月28日墨西拿地震救援；1911年乘「翁貝托國王」號參加義土戰爭。
body.en: Iachino (spelled Jachino by Treccani) was born at San Remo on 24 April 1889 and entered the Naval Academy on 15 August 1904. Aboard the battleship Regina Margherita he took part in relief work after the Messina earthquake of 28 December 1908, and in 1911 he served on the battleship Re Umberto in the Italo-Turkish war.

citations.quote: Nacque a San Remo il 24 apr. 1889
Entrato in Accademia navale il 15 ag. 1904
terremoto di Messina del 28 dic. 1908
l'anno seguente prese parte alla guerra italo-turca

heading.en: From the First World War to 1939

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰中他在戰艦「尤利烏斯·凱撒」號服役至1917年6月22日，1918年5月8日指揮魚雷艇「66 PN」。1922年5月16日他出任駐華海軍分遣隊指揮官，1931年5月至1934年7月任駐倫敦海軍武官；1939年春參與佔領阿爾巴尼亞，同年9月16日晉升艦隊上將。
body.en: In the First World War he served on the battleship Giulio Cesare until 22 June 1917 and on 8 May 1918 took command of the torpedo boat 66 PN. On 16 May 1922 he became commander of the Royal Navy detachment in China, and was naval attaché in London from May 1931 to July 1934. In spring 1939 he took part in the occupation of Albania and on 16 September 1939 was promoted ammiraglio di squadra.

citations.quote: rimase fino al 22 giugno 1917
l'8 maggio 1918 ebbe il comando della torpediniera
il 16 maggio 1922 fu nominato comandante del distaccamento della R. Marina
dal 1° maggio 1931 al 26 luglio 1934, fu addetto navale a Londra
Nella primavera del 1939 prese parte all'occupazione dell'Albania
Il 16 sett. 1939 fu nominato ammiraglio di squadra

body.zh-Hant: 1940年7月26日他接任第2戰隊司令，旗艦為重巡洋艦「波拉」號。8月31日至9月初，他參與抵制英軍「帽子」行動；11月27日參加特拉達角海戰，下令拖帶受損的驅逐艦「蘭恰列」號返回卡利亞里。12月10日他升任艦隊總司令。
body.en: On 26 July 1940 he took command of the 2nd Squadron, flying his flag on the heavy cruiser Pola. Between 31 August and early September 1940 he took part in countering Operation Hats; on 27 November he took part in the action off Cape Teulada, ordering the damaged destroyer Lanciere to be towed back to Cagliari. On 10 December he became commander in chief of the fleet.

citations.quote: il 26 luglio 1940 ebbe il comando della 2ª squadra
tra il 31 agosto e i primi di settembre 1940
Il 27 novembre partecipò allo scontro di capo Teulada
riuscendo a farlo rientrare a Cagliari
Il 10 dicembre lo J. divenne comandante in capo della squadra navale

body.zh-Hant: 1941年3月28日，他在加烏多附近與英軍巡洋艦群交手，旗艦「維托里奧·維內托」號受損，重巡「波拉」號被擊癱。當晚在馬塔潘附近，前往救援的意軍艦艇遭英軍攔截，驅逐艦「阿爾菲耶里」「卡爾杜齊」與巡洋艦「菲烏梅」「札拉」及「波拉」被擊沉，死亡逾2300人。他仍保住職務。
body.en: On 28 March 1941 he clashed with a group of British cruisers near Gaudo; his flagship Vittorio Veneto was damaged and the cruiser Pola immobilised. That evening near Matapan the Italian ships sent to help were intercepted and the destroyers Alfieri and Carducci and the cruisers Fiume, Zara and Pola were sunk, with over 2,300 crew dead. Despite this defeat he kept his post.

citations.quote: la mattina del 28 marzo lo J. si scontrò, vicino a Gaudo
danneggiare la corazzata "Vittorio Veneto"
immobilizzare l'incrociatore "Pola"
La sera dello stesso 28 marzo, vicino a Matapan
provocando la morte di oltre 2300 membri degli equipaggi

heading.en: The Sirte battles and later career

body.zh-Hant: 1941年12月他指揮意軍參加第一次錫德拉灣海戰，保住了運往利比亞的船團；1942年3月第二次錫德拉灣海戰中他被評為過於謹慎。1942年4月6日他獲任命為預定集團軍上將，兩個多月後參加六月中旬戰役；1943年4月5日離開艦隊司令職位，次日升任海軍上將。他於1976年12月3日在羅馬去世。
body.en: In December 1941 he commanded the Italian forces in the first battle of Sirte, ensuring a convoy reached Libya; in March 1942 at the second Sirte he again showed excessive caution. On 6 April 1942 he was named ammiraglio di squadra designato d'armata and soon after took part in the mid-June battle. On 5 April 1943 he left command of the fleet and the next day became ammiraglio d'armata. He died in Rome on 3 December 1976.

body.zh-Hant: 1941年3月15日，德國海軍總司令雷德爾召亞基諾赴柏林。3月26日夜他從那不勒斯出海，行動代號「加烏多」，計畫3月28日在克里特島南北搜索英軍船團。義大利媒體稱他率「維托里奧·維內托」號、8艘巡洋艦與13艘驅逐艦出動；該戰死亡2335人。
body.en: On 15 March 1941 Grand Admiral Raeder summoned Iachino to Berlin. He sailed from Naples late on 26 March for the operation code-named Gaudo, which planned a sweep north and south of Crete on 28 March against the British convoys. Avvenire says he led the Vittorio Veneto, 8 cruisers and 13 destroyers; 2,335 men died in the action.

body.zh-Hant: 陳納德在路易斯安那長大，1917年4月入伍，1919年完成飛行訓練，1920年取得正規軍官任命。1930年他被派到空軍航空兵戰術學校主持驅逐機（追擊機）組，主張戰鬥機能攔截並擊潰轟炸機編隊，與校內戰略轟炸論相左；1937年因身體殘疾退役。
body.en: Chennault grew up in Louisiana, joined the army in April 1917, completed pilot training in 1919 and obtained a regular commission in 1920. In 1930 he was sent to the Air Corps Tactical School to head the Pursuit Section, arguing that fighters could intercept and decimate bomber formations, against the school's strategic-bombing theory; he retired in 1937 because of physical disability.

heading.en: China and the American Volunteer Group

body.zh-Hant: 1937年5月陳納德前往中國，並結識蔣介石夫人宋美齡；他成為中國政府的航空顧問。1941年4月15日羅斯福簽署行政命令，批准為美國志願大隊招募預備役軍人；同年7月7日首批人員自舊金山出發。
body.en: Chennault went to China in May 1937, met Madame Chiang Kai-shek and became aviation adviser to the Chinese government. On 15 April 1941 Roosevelt signed an executive order authorising the recruitment of reserve military personnel for the American Volunteer Group, and on 7 July the first contingent sailed from San Francisco.

body.zh-Hant: 飛虎隊於1941年12月至1942年7月參與對日空戰。1942年2月25日日軍出動166架飛機轟炸仰光；3月7日仰光陷落後，陳納德把最後的戰鬥機撤回中國。美國志願大隊在1942年7月4日解散，改編為由他指揮的中國空軍特遣隊。據梅林格所述，飛虎隊在有限的作戰期間擊落近300架日機，自身只損失12架。
body.en: The Flying Tigers were in action from December 1941 to July 1942. On 25 February 1942 the Japanese sent 166 planes against Rangoon; after Rangoon fell on 7 March 1942 Chennault withdrew his last fighters to China. The AVG was disbanded on 4 July 1942 and formed into the China Air Task Force with Chennault in command. Meilinger writes that the Tigers shot down nearly 300 Japanese aircraft for the loss of only 12 of their own.

body.zh-Hant: 1943年3月陳納德晉升少將，出任第十四航空隊司令，從華南基地支援史迪威的中美地面部隊。他任職至1945年8月，同年10月退役；他與史迪威不和，並直接向蔣介石和羅斯福陳情。他在1958年7月去世前九天晉升中將。
body.en: In March 1943 Chennault was promoted to major general and given command of the Fourteenth Air Force, which from bases in southern China fought a war of attrition and tactical support for Stilwell's Chinese and US ground forces. He remained in command until August 1945 and retired that October. He feuded with Stilwell and dealt directly with Chiang Kai-shek and Roosevelt. He was promoted to lieutenant general nine days before his death in July 1958.

body.zh-Hant: 斯帕茨1891年生於賓夕法尼亞州，1914年自西點軍校畢業，分發步兵，一年後轉入航空勤務隊受飛行訓練。第一次世界大戰中他被派往法國，負責伊蘇敦訓練機場，後來調往前線作戰，擊落兩架德機，獲頒傑出服役十字勳章。
body.en: Spaatz was born in Pennsylvania in 1891, graduated from West Point in 1914 and was posted to the infantry; a year later he transferred to the Air Service for pilot training. In the First World War he was sent to France and put in charge of the training airfield at Issoudun; he later flew in combat, shot down two German aircraft and was awarded the Distinguished Service Cross.

heading.en: Interwar years and early Second World War

body.zh-Hant: 戰間期他歷任各級指揮與參謀職，並在1929年1月創下連續飛行逾六天的「問號」號空中加油飛行任務中擔任飛行員。二戰爆發時他在阿諾德領導的航空參謀部服務，隨後被派往歐洲，先在英國指揮第八航空隊，再南下指揮北非登陸的美軍航空部隊。
body.en: In the interwar years he was a commander and staff officer at all levels and piloted the Question Mark flight of January 1929, which stayed aloft for over six days. When the Second World War broke out he served on the Air Staff under Arnold but was soon sent to Europe, first as Eighth Air Force commander in England and then to command the American air forces for the invasion of North Africa.

heading.en: The strategic air war over Europe

body.zh-Hant: 美國駐歐戰略空軍於1944年1月1日成立，統一指揮英國的第八航空隊與義大利的第十五航空隊，斯帕茨自成立起指揮該司令部。1944年2月進行「大週」行動，其後斯帕茨主張優先轟炸德國石油，但艾森豪為諾曼第登陸採用交通運輸計畫，斯帕茨才轉向石油目標。
body.en: United States Strategic Air Forces in Europe was established on 1 January 1944 to unify the Eighth Air Force in England and the Fifteenth Air Force in Italy, and Spaatz took command at its creation. Big Week came in February 1944. Spaatz believed oil was the key to the German economy, but Eisenhower opted for the Transportation Plan against the railways for the Normandy invasion, and only then did Spaatz focus on German oil production.

body.zh-Hant: 德國於1945年5月投降後，美國駐歐戰略空軍解散，斯帕茨轉往太平洋指揮美國陸軍戰略空軍，原子彈投向日本時由他負責。戰後他返回華盛頓接掌陸軍航空軍，處理航空兵復員；1947年9月美國空軍獨立後，成為首任空軍參謀長，約八個月後選擇退役。
body.en: After Germany's surrender in May 1945 USSTAF was dissolved and Spaatz moved to command the US Army Strategic Air Forces in the Pacific, where he was in charge when the atomic bombs were dropped on Japan. Returning to Washington he took command of the Army Air Forces and oversaw demobilisation; the Air Force became independent in September 1947 and he became its first Chief of Staff, retiring about eight months later.
